g.text: Round 15 | Identical logistic probes on two frozen representations
Same 141 historical weeks, 2018-2020. Diamonds are ensemble results; open circles are fixed seeds (not confidence intervals).
Probe threshold: p > 0.5. Dotted line: neutral p = 0.5 Brier reference. These repeatedly inspected dates provide exploratory evidence.
